description: Given a research question, specify the intervention and the measurement apparatus: the canonical form, an eight-primitive design checklist, a worked example (Essays), and the rules for recording version and configuration.
How the Evaluchat essays feature gates drafting support behind dialogic contribution (CAMDLE), as implemented in Canvas — the implementation source of truth.

The Canvas platform's configurable surface for research apparatuses: AI modes, drafting gates, and telemetry, pinned to a shipped platform version. Apparatus specs reference this vocabulary for their knobs.

A research apparatus is a reproducible configuration of Canvas capabilities, workflows, and measurements designed to investigate one or more research questions and produce specified evidence — the four-dimension invariant, epistemic spine, versioning and configuration model.
